description: An evidence bundle: a minimal interpretation of an artifact (data, observation, experimental outcome) that can support or oppose claims. In this grammar, evidence is the ONLY record type that can support or oppose a claim (see tech.scios.rrgi.supports/opposes — 'Evidence is the only Argument'), which is why it is deliberately separated from claims as a first-class type: the separation makes it assessable what is known empirically vs. what is asserted, and no chain of assertions can manufacture apparent empirical backing. Grounded in the MIRA community schema (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml, Evidence class); first ported (2026-05) from the DiscourseGraphs coalition's org.discoursegraphs.evidence (github.com/DiscourseGraphs/schemas) — historical lineage, kept as attribution. Dual-addressing of every reference is an RRGI extension intended to be proposed upstream.

text.description: The evidence statement: a minimal interpretation of data or observations from a specific study or experiment.

description.description: Optional additional context: methods, conditions, limitations, or contextual details (e.g., apparatus, sample, task parameters) needed to interpret this evidence.

contextEntities.description: Aboutness: the concrete concepts and entities this evidence is about (e.g. phenomena, materials, instruments, datasets, populations, tasks) — the same field claims and questions carry. Records point at external subject authorities rather than minting an internal entity registry, following Wikidata P921 'main subject' ('primary topic of a work or act of communication') and schema.org 'about' ('The subject matter of an object'); each entry's optional uri resolves to the external authority. MIRA's closest anchor is observationBase (Evidence→Entity, a prov:Entity) — marked provisional upstream, noted as the eventual convergence point (the link itself, from evidence to a data record, exists since 2026-10-03 as tech.scios.rrgi.observationBase). Stamped at authoring/decomposition time; enables 'find all evidence about concept X' and shared-concept joins across literatures.

plotReading.description: True when the value this evidence states was read off a plot (shown as 'read from the plot'): never finer than the plot's axis allows. Written by the extraction pipeline's figure step (pipeline-v5, 2026-10-04) on the evidence it states from a figure; false there when the statement is not a reading off a plot; absent on other evidence.

claimless.description: True when no claim bears on this evidence: the figure step stated what a figure shows, and no claim of the paper is supported or opposed by it (pipeline-v5, 2026-10-04). Absent otherwise.

name.description: Name or identifier of the concept or entity. Prefer specific over generic — a rare, precise concept is worth more to discovery than a broad one.

uri.description: Optional URI identifying this entity in an external ontology or knowledge base (e.g. a Wikidata item) — the P921/about pattern: reference external authorities, never mint an internal registry.
